system.description:
The Song of Merriment brings joy to all who hear it. Sadness is washed away and fatigue forgotten.

Obstacle: See description. Wonderment, Ob 1. Negate +1 Ob penalty, Ob 2. Alleviate -1D penalty for one scene, Ob 3. Prevent and cancel all ongoing hesitation, Ob 4.

Actions: 120

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 150
